summary: Add pp:typed-exit-codes to credits, video watch, project, and scenes gaps/scenes so a real typed API rejection of a synthetic credential or placeholder ID counts as a live-dogfood pass instead of a hard failure.
reason: These commands need a real harvested browser key or a real per-account project ID that can never be shipped in source; a real API call that reaches the endpoint and gets a typed auth/not-found response proves the wiring works, which is the most the matrix can prove without live secrets.
